Wi-Fi asset visibility for scientific facilities

Know where your critical equipment is—without changing how your facility works.

Active Property Tag gives service groups a practical view of the last known location, status, and movement history of high-value shared equipment.

Request a demo See how it works

Shared equipment should not disappear across campus.

Vacuum carts, leak detectors, network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, and other mobile instruments are often loaned for weeks or months. When teams lose track of them, staff spend time searching, equipment appears unavailable, and facilities may buy assets they already own.

Location visibility using the Wi-Fi infrastructure you already have.

A compact tag periodically connects to the nearest existing access point and reports that connection to the Blinky-Lite control platform. Known access-point locations turn the signal into a practical last-known location.

01

Attach the tag

Place a compact, battery-powered tag on an equipment cart or instrument.

02

Wake and report

The tag wakes on a schedule, connects to nearby Wi-Fi, and sends location and battery status.

03

View in Blinky-Lite

See last known location, device status, and movement history in one place.

04

Receive alerts

Be notified about low battery power or an expected check-in that did not arrive.
